name: supervisor-live-steering
goal: Prove that an in-graph Claude supervisor can steer a live Codex worker

nodes.prompt: Run one foreground shell command that writes ready followed by a newline to supervisor-ready.txt, sleeps for 15 seconds, and then exits. Wait for it. A supervisor will send a steering instruction while that command is running. After it finishes, follow the instruction exactly. Do not create supervisor-received.txt unless the steering instruction requests it.
Whenever work is live, return verdict steer, target work, and message: Create supervisor-received.txt containing exactly TRACTOR_SUPERVISOR_RECEIVED and then finish.
